# Domain-purity baseline (ADR-0002) — grandfathered violations, BURN DOWN ONLY.
# Never add entries: a new framework import in the domain layer fails CI outright.
# Delete a line here in the same PR that fixes (or removes) the import.
#
# The eight openbank-libs-domain Jackson entries below were added by #3670, when the gate's
# scope was widened from the `*/domain/*` PACKAGE PATH to the whole openbank-libs-domain
# MODULE. They are NOT new code — they had been in the tree the whole time, in a part of the
# module the gate never opened (80 of its 107 main sources). Widening a gate's scope always
# uncovers pre-existing violations, and grandfathering them is what makes the widening
# shippable; #3670 fixed the ten it could fix outright (the @Authorize/@FeatureFlag CDI
# interceptor bindings moved to libs-runtime, three jboss-logging Loggers became the JDK's
# System.Logger) and left these eight because each needs a real refactor, not a move:
#   - ApiError / CursorPage: wire DTOs whose @JsonInclude shapes the HTTP envelope. Fixing
#     them means a serialization boundary in libs-runtime, not deleting an annotation.
#   - OpaSidecarPolicyDecisionPoint / FlagdProvider: HTTP+Jackson infrastructure adapters
#     that sit in libs-domain and should move to libs-runtime (also flagged in #3670).
#   - CompliancePackParser: parses a JSON compliance pack; needs a port/adapter split.
# Tracked in #3670. Do not add further entries.
